book.name: First name

privacy.body: We use your name and contact details only to run this appointment and are asked to delete them soon after. Your link is the only way to see or change the booking.
privacy.retention: We delete your name and contact details {{count}} day after your appointment.
privacy.retention_other: We delete your name and contact details {{count}} days after your appointment.

book.taken: That time was just taken. Here are the times that are still open.

error.slot_full: That time was just taken. Here are the times that are still open.
error.slot_unavailable: That time is no longer available. Here are the times that are still open.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.captcha_required: We couldn't confirm you're not a robot. Wait for the check to finish, then try again.
error.captcha_failed: The robot check didn't pass. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
error.org_suspended: This business isn't taking bookings right now.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_input: Check the details and try again.

book.contactRequired: Add a phone number or an email so we can reach you if the event changes.

notFound.title: Appointment not found
notFound.body: This link is wrong or has expired.

appointment.title: Your appointment
appointment.pending: Your time is held for a few minutes. It is confirmed once your card is accepted, and released if that does not happen.
appointment.payUnavailable: We could not reach the payment service. Try again.
appointment.cancelBody: Your time will be given to someone else.
appointment.notYou: Did you not book this? Cancel it below and the time goes back to the business.
appointment.tooLate: It's too close to the appointment to change it online. Please contact the business.
appointment.rescheduleTaken: That time was just taken. Pick another.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Reminders are emailed to the address you gave when you booked, before your appointment. You can also get them on this device or add the appointment to your calendar.
reminders.on: Reminders are on for this device.
reminders.unsupported: This browser can't show reminders. Add the appointment to your calendar instead.
reminders.failed: Couldn't turn reminders on. Try again.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to get reminders.
reminders.homeScreen: On iPhone, reminders need this page on your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there.
reminders.keepOpen: This browser can't show reminders. Add the appointment to your calendar instead.

events.none: No events are open for booking.

error.event_full: Sorry, there aren't enough seats left. Pick another event or fewer seats.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
error.org_suspended: Booking is paused for this place.
error.not_found: That event is no longer open.
error.invalid_input: Check the details and try again.

waitlist.prompt: Can't find a time that works? We'll email you if one opens up.
waitlist.summary: Waitlist: we'll email you when a matching time opens up.
waitlist.windowHint: Leave the times empty to accept any time that day.
waitlist.windowInvalid: Pick both times, with the second after the first.
waitlist.emailRequired: Add your email: that's how we offer you a time.

offer.title: Your waitlist spot

notFound.title: We can't find that waitlist spot
notFound.body: The link may be old. Check the email we sent you.

offer.waitingFor: We'll email you if a time opens up on {{day}}.
offer.holdLeft_one: Held for you for about {{count}} more minute, until {{until}} (as of {{asOf}}).
offer.holdLeft_other: Held for you for about {{count}} more minutes, until {{until}} (as of {{asOf}}).
offer.declineBody: It goes to the next person on the waitlist.
offer.leaveBody: You won't be offered a time on this day any more.

error.offer_expired: Sorry, this offer ran out. You're no longer on the waitlist for it.
error.slot_taken: Sorry, that time is no longer available.
error.rate_limited: You already have too many unpaid bookings. Pay for or cancel one, then claim this offer before it runs out.
error.not_found: We can't find that offer any more.

payment.title: Secure your booking

mode.hold: We will place a hold of {{amount}} on your card. Nothing is charged now.
mode.deposit: A deposit of {{amount}} is charged to your card now.
mode.card_on_file: We will save your card. Nothing is charged now, and a no-show fee of {{amount}} may be charged if you miss your appointment.
mode.pos: {{amount}} is charged to your card now.

policy.hold_one: Cancel at least {{count}} hour before your appointment and the hold is released.
policy.hold_other: Cancel at least {{count}} hours before your appointment and the hold is released.
policy.deposit_one: Cancel at least {{count}} hour before your appointment and your deposit is refunded.
policy.deposit_other: Cancel at least {{count}} hours before your appointment and your deposit is refunded.
policy.card_on_file_one: Cancel at least {{count}} hour before your appointment to avoid the fee.
policy.card_on_file_other: Cancel at least {{count}} hours before your appointment to avoid the fee.
policy.pos: For a refund, ask the staff here.

error.failed: We could not complete the payment. Check your card details and try again.
error.unavailable: We could not reach the payment service. Try again.

payment.posTestMode: This install has no card processor connected, so no card can be entered and nothing is charged.

payCode.ended: It may have expired, been replaced, or already been paid. If you still need to pay, ask the staff for a new code.
